requirement: One-time hints show once per account, across browsers and devices

oracle.invariant: A fresh browser does not show the site tour or the voice tip when the account has seen them. Finishing a hint records it on the account; an old browser mark is recorded on the account once and removed. A failed read does not show the hint. The desktop app does not reopen the first-run tour for an account that completed it.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: a previously seen account does not see the tip on a fresh browser
legacy browser state is copied to the account then removed
account seen hints suppress the site tour in a fresh browser
a failed seen-hint read hides the site tour
desktop stage 1 through the surface overlay uses account completion on a new device
the desktop surface: the account decides both flags
